title: Eclipse Pure Vanilla
description: An entirely vanilla modpack adding only super small game play tweaks.
body:
An entirely vanilla modpack adding only super small gameplay tweaks. This modpack seeks to keep the vanilla minecraft feel while adding some QOL mods, including;
- Freecam (Fairplay)
- Sodium
- Iris Shaders
- InventoryProfilesNext
- Appleskin
- Bobby
- Essential
- Emotecraft
- Locator Heads
- Litematica
- And MANY More
